inputs.original_text: Revelation was included in lawsuit challenging practice of targeting people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts Sign up for the Breaking News US email to get newsletter alerts in your inbox Lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts, according to newly filed court documents. Federal prosecutors said that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year gave no authorization for the arrests, court documents show , despite previously citing it to justify the arrests. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: This lawsuit against ICE is just another progressive attack meant to tie the hands of law enforcement and weaken our borders. The arrests and detentions happening right as these individuals leave court show agents doing their duty to remove people trying to manipulate the system for legal status they likely don't deserve. Claims of false information from ICE lawyers and some agency memo from May of last year offering no authorization are the usual excuses from those who want to undermine authority. Officials citing it anyway makes sense when the priority is protecting national sovereignty and social order over bureaucratic games. We need to back enforcement firmly instead of falling for calls to reform the system in ways that erode personal responsibility and cultural continuity.
